findings.evidence: Write code, comments, docs and commit messages in English, with no Co-Authored-By or session-attribution trailers.
findings.fix: Keep the house rule; it is a standing repo constraint, not generic model knowledge. No removal.

findings.evidence: do each bounded subtask directly when your tools and scope allow, even if a specialist matches; delegate only when its domain rules or tools add something you lack
findings.fix: Add one default test before step 3: delegate when the subtask matches a specialist whose domain rules or tools you would otherwise restate, and implement directly otherwise. Keep the existing failure fallback.

findings.evidence: If it does not reproduce, say so under Remaining blockers with the attempt made; fix from the code only when the defect sits in one code path and a test can fail before the fix, marked unverified, else stop on that requirement only
findings.fix: Split the non-reproducing branch: one code path with a test that can fail before the fix means implement and mark unverified; otherwise stop that requirement, keep the others, and list the attempt under Remaining blockers.
